# FaculZo

> FaculZo is a campus platform made by Nagendra Global Innovations (NGI): three connected apps for students, staff and gate security, covering attendance, notes, leave requests, gate passes and notices.

- Website: https://faculzo.nagendraglobalinnovations.in/
- Made by: Nagendra Global Innovations, https://nagendraglobalinnovations.in/ (Vizianagaram, Andhra Pradesh, India)
- Founder and CEO: Mudunuru Avinash Varma, https://avinashmudunuru.in/
- Registration: Registered on Startup India BHASKAR (ID: IN-1126-9577DW)
- BHASKAR public profile: https://www.startupindia.gov.in/bhaskar/profile?bhaskarid=IN-1126-9577DW
- Contact: ceo@nagendraglobalinnovations.in
